# #1900: Patch: a failed live co-op read on Together still offers the way back
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

On the Together screen, the 'Back to your co-op game' link is the only way back into a live co-op match. Today, if the single read behind it hiccups, the link simply never appears and the screen looks as if there were no game to return to — a stranded player. After this, the read explains its failure and offers Try again, exactly like the decks list in the same panel already does.

## Why

`CoopPanel.tsx:111-122` calls `getDuosLive()` once at mount with a silent `() => undefined` rejection; on failure `live` stays null and the `coopRejoin` link (229-231) never renders. `LiveGameBanner` is only mounted on `/landing` and `/practice`, so on `/together` this link is the sole rejoin affordance. The same file's `useSavedDecks` (67-89, 287-296) already models `loadError`/`retry` with a `coopDecksRetry` button.

## Proposal

Mirror the saved-decks load-error/retry pattern for the live-duos read.

## Where it lands

`apps/web/src/duos/CoopPanel.tsx:67-89, 111-122, 229-231, 287-296`; test `CoopPanel.test.tsx` (its `serve()` stub already handles `GET /api/duos/live`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A refused `GET /api/duos/live` shows a local alert plus Try again.
- [ ] A successful retry renders the `coop-rejoin` link.
- [ ] Existing CoopPanel tests pass.

## Size and risks

Small, likely difficulty easy: one component plus its test; the pattern to copy sits in the same file.
